educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In Japanese Seminar, students receive an introduction to Japanese culture through
lectures and hands-on experiences. Students will attend lectures given by experts
in various topics related to Japanese culture and deepen their understanding throu
gh group discussions, reflection activities, and group projects. Students will con
duct field research on a topic related to Japanese culture and share their finding
s with other students in the class.
advice:
This course consists of 1) acquiring knowledge through pre-class readings and in-class lectures; 2) deepening an
d personalizing this knowledge through in-class discussions and reflection assignments; and 3) consolidating and
 synthesizing what they have learned through real-world observations and field work, culminating in a group pres
entation to share what they have learned.

Japanese culture topics include: everyday life of a college student in Japan, daily activities, special occasion
s (festivals, special holidays, etc.), working in Japan, Kanazawa architecture, and religion in Japan.

Course work consists of in-class activities and independent inquiry activities.
